AK-2025-HJR28.aiSummary: This resolution asks Congress to pass the Kids Online Safety Act. The act would require some online platforms to add safety tools for users under 17, give parents more controls, and add more public reporting and checks. It also would limit certain data use and set up an advisory council on risks to minors online.

AK-2025-HB52.aiSummary: The bill would give minors at psychiatric hospitals the right to weekly private phone or video time with a parent, guardian, or other approved adult, unless a court order, law, or medical judgment says no. It would require hospitals to report each use of seclusion or restraint on a minor to the Department of Health and the parent or guardian within 72 hours, and the department would publish a yearly report on these cases and related inspections. It would also require unannounced inspections of certain psychiatric hospitals at least twice a year and take effect on July 1, 2027.
